id.description: A unique identifier for the membership.

personEmail.description: The email address of the person.

personDisplayName.description: The display name of the person.

personOrgId.description: The organization ID of the person.

isModerator.description: Whether or not the participant is a room moderator.

isRoomHidden.description: Whether or not the direct type room is hidden in the Webex clients.

roomType.description:
The type of room the membership is associated with.
 * `direct` - 1:1 room.
 * `group` - Group room.

isMonitor.description: Whether or not the participant is a monitoring bot (deprecated).

created.description: The date and time when the membership was created.
